name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown Menu
description: A button-triggered command menu — items, checkbox and radio items, submenus, plus a `Compose` array shorthand. Wraps @base-ui/react/menu: Base UI owns open state, positioning, focus and typeahead; we own the popup and the rows.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/dropdown-menu

Installed to `components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/dropdown-menu

Requires the `@interlace/theme` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency).
